summary: Frontend-only testing of the Ledger/Kit marketing landing page at mobile (390x844) and desktop (1440x820) viewports. All requested features verified as working: mobile Showcase gallery is responsive with horizontally scrollable tab list & horizontally scrollable image area (image renders at 760px inside scroll container, no page overflow), tab switching updates image + caption, desktop auto-play advances every ~4.2s and pauses on hover, hero renders with floating stat chips + vector graphics without horizontal overflow, sticky buy bar appears after scrollY>760 and hides near footer, countdown timer decrements (14:54 -> 14:51), all three Buy CTAs (hero, pricing, sticky) open the modal, and email submit -> processing -> success view exposes a download link href='/business-management-toolkit.xlsx'. Testimonials and Pricing sections render fine.
critical_code_review_comments: StickyBuy countdown uses localStorage 'lk_deadline' which persists across sessions - after 15 min the timer stays at 00:00 with no reset/urgency refresh. Consider auto-resetting or hiding once expired.
Showcase mobile scroll container uses hard-coded w-[760px] - works but any image with different intrinsic aspect could look off. Acceptable for MVP.
Hero right column mouse-tilt is calibrated for desktop; mobile touch has no effect (fine, intentional).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page is a static React marketing site with mocked checkout (BuyModal). Full end-to-end flow validated on both viewports. Screenshots captured at .screenshots/mobile_showcase.png, mobile_showcase_tab6.png, desktop_hero.png. Countdown deadline is stored in localStorage 'lk_deadline'; clear it if you need a fresh 15:00 for testing.
